This is a specific 2019 survey figure, so I’ll check the source before stating the percentage.About 80% of Americans said in 2019 that it is very important to have a free media that can report without government or state censorship. That figure comes from the Pew Research Center’s Spring 2019 Global Attitudes Survey, which asked how important that kind of press freedom is in their country.
CONFIDENCE: 72
